column1: # Every entry here is an accepted, reviewable exception. The default for anything not
# listed is the scan's own level, and `-I` fails the job on any High or Medium alert, so
# adding a line is how a finding is consciously accepted rather than silently tolerated.
# 10049 (Storable and Cacheable Content): hashed SPA assets are immutable and public by
# design (`frontend/nginx.conf`); the API sets `Cache-Control: private, no-store`.

column3: Hashed static assets are public and immutable by design; API responses are no-store.

column1: # 10063 (Permissions Policy Header): the SPA sends a Permissions-Policy; the API is JSON
# only and does not need one.

column3: API responses are JSON; the SPA sets the policy.

column1: # 10109 (Modern Web Application): informational, asks for a SPA crawler. The four
# journeys are covered by Playwright (`docs/37` §7), not by a scanner crawl.

column3: SPA journeys are covered by the Playwright suite.
